description: The owning role of each UI-boundary slice under the frozen v4.1.4 file ownership (requirements-compiled/v4.1.4/agent-file-ownership.json: 'ui and ui-2 never own the same file'). The slice manifest gives every UI slice the boundary 'ui'; schedule.fsx lets either UI lane take any of them. A slice is ui-2's only when the view file it implements is ui-2's; every other UI slice stays ui's (the default, not listed).

SL-T23.basis: T23 'Causal graph with the existing workflow layout engine' implements src/Causa.App/Views/Graph.fs, owned by ui-2

SL-T28.basis: T28 'History, time travel and semantic diff' implements src/Causa.App/Views/History.fs, owned by ui-2
